filter-on-desc: Tiquinchipahua amatlapaltin ipan inin huapalli. Xictoca nican inic ticpatlas tlachipahualiztli.
advanced-filter-description: Hueyi tlachipahualiztli mitzcahuilia xictlahcuilo ce tlahtolli tlen quipia inin tequitiltin: == != <= >= && || ( ) Ce cahcahualli quinxeloa tequitiltin. Huel tiquinchipahuas mochi monemac tlaltin ica intocayo ihuan impatiuh. Machiyotl: Field1 == Value1. Tlanonotzaliztli: Intla tlaltin noso patiuhtin quipiah cahcahualli, xiquintzacuati ica zan ce tlahtolmachiyotl. Machiyotl: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Inic ticpanos zan ce tlanahuatilmachiotl (' \/), huel tictequihuis \. Machiyotl: Field1 == I\'m. Noihqui huel ticnelos miyac tlamantli. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Mochipa mochi tequitiltin mocaquih itech opochtli hasta yecma. Huel ticpatlas tlatecpanaliztli ica tiquintlalis tlatzacuatin. Machiyotl: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Noihqui huel tictemos tlahtoltlaltin ica regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
imported-member-no-account: Tlacatl calaquic — ayamo onca tlacatequitilamatl namictih
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Xicpepecho ce Kanboard tlaquixtilli JSON: ce tlamantli ica "columns" (noso tequitl ica column_name) ihuan ce "tasks" tlatecpanalli (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan tasks mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-deck: Xicpepecho ce NextCloud Deck huapalli JSON (ce huapalli ica "stacks", sesen stack quipia "cards"). Stacks mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan cards mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Xicpepecho ce OpenProject work-packages nechicoliztli JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan work packages mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-issues: Xicpepecho ce __sourceName__ ahcuallotl JSON tlatecpanalli (__endpoint__). Ahcuallotin mocuepah amatlapaltin tlatecpanaltin ipan Open / Closed tocatlahtoltin.
import-board-instruction-asana: Xicpepecho ce Asana tequitl tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "data": [...] } itech Asana tlaquixtilli noso GET /tasks). Tequitl monechicoa ipan secciones (memberships); tequitl tlamic yauh Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Xicpepecho ce ZenKit tocatlahtolli tlaquixtilli JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan items mocuepah amatlapaltin.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ipan moTrello huapalli, xiyauh 'Menu', niman 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', ihuan xiccopina tlahtolli monextic.
import-board-instruction-csv: Xicpepecho moComma Separated Values (CSV) / Tab Separated Values (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Xicpepecho JSON itech Jira Cloud REST API ahcuallotl temoliztli (GET /rest/api/2/search), noso ce namictih { "issues": [...] } tlamantli. Jira statuses mocuepah tocatlahtoltin ihuan issues mocuepah amatlapaltin. Huel ticaquitis ce "automationRules" tlatecpanalli inic tiquincalaquis nahuatiltin.
import-board-instruction-excel: Xicpehpena ce WeKan-machiyotl .xlsx tlapoualtlacuilolli (san se columnas quemeh Excel tlaquixtilli: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Achto fila cah tlacpac tocayotl.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ipan mohuapalli, xiyauh 'Menu', niman 'Export board', ihuan xiccopina tlahtolli ipan archivo temohuiloc.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Intla tiquittaz ahcuallotin ihcuac ticcalaquia huapalli, quemman calaquiliztli tequiti ihuan huapalli cah ipan Nochi Huapaltin amatl.

import-trello-zip-file-hint: Ce .zip ica ce noso miyac huapalli .json archivos ihuan intlanamictilhuan ipan huapalli-tocayotl carpetas (itech Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Mochi huapaltin mocalaquiah.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Temoliztin huel quipiah tequitiltin inic ocachi melahuac temoliztli. Tequitiltin motlahcuiloah ica itocayo ihuan ipatiuh moxeloh ica colon. Machiyotl, `list:Blocked` quinepantlalis temoliztli ipan amatlapaltin tlen oncateh ipan ce tocatlahtolli itocayo *Blocked*. Intla ipatiuh quipia cahcahualli noso iyoca machiyotl, monequi motzacua ica tlahtolmachiyotl (machiyotl `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - amatlapaltin tlen quipiah ce machiotl namictih ica *<color>* noso *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amatlapaltin ipan ce huapalli tlanahuatilli ipan nechicoliztli *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amatlapaltin ipan ce huapalli tlanahuatilli ipan tlanechicolli *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amatlapaltin tlen tlamizqueh ipan *<n>* tonaltin itech axcan. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ quinnextia mochi amatlapaltin tlen ya opanoc intlamiliztonal.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amatlapaltin tlachihualtin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amatlapaltin patlaltin ipan *<n>* tonaltin noso achi
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - mochi amatlapaltin pixcalco ihuan amo pixcalco
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - campa *<field>* cah ce itech `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` noso `__predicate_member__`. Xiclalili `-` iixpan *<field>* inic tictemos amo oncayotl ipan inon tlalli (machiyotl `has:-due` quitemoa amatlapaltin amo tlamiliztonalli).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - campa *<sort-name>* cah ce itech `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` noso `__predicate_modified__`. Inic tictecpanas temoc, xiclalili `-` iixpan tlatecpanaliztocayotl.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - campa *<n>* cah ce positivo tlapoualli tlen quimati amatlapaltin tlapoualli tlanextililo ipan sesen amatl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Tequitiltin san se monepanoah ica *OR*. Amatlapaltin namictih ica ce tlamantli mocuepah.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` quincuepaz amatlapaltin ipan ce tocatlahtolli itocayo *Blocked* noso *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Tequitiltin iyoca monepanoah ica *AND*. Zan amatlapaltin namictih ica mochi iyoca tlamantli mocuepah. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` quincuepa zan amatlapaltin ipan tocatlahtolli *Available* ica machiotl *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Tonaltin huel motlaliah quemeh positivo noso negativo tlapoualli, noso ica `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` noso `__predicate_year__` para axcan cahuitl.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Tlahtol temoliztin amo quixeloah hueyi ihuan tzinco tlahtolli.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Ica tlachihualmachiyotl, amatlapaltin pixcalco amo motemoah.

azure-connection-string-description: Optional: use a full connection string instead of account name and key.
database-migration-description: Migrate text-based data (everything except attachments and avatars, which stay on the filesystem) between MongoDB and FerretDB v1 (SQLite). The other database must be running and reachable (default ports: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; override with WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). After it finishes, point MONGO_URL at the other database and restart WeKan (on Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb or =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Migrate text data to FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Copy all text-based collections to __db__? Attachments and avatars on the filesystem are not affected. The target database must be running.
sandstorm-migration-description: When WeKan runs inside a Sandstorm grain, its old MongoDB 3 database is migrated to FerretDB v1 (SQLite) on first launch, and attachments and avatars are moved from the database to the grain's files/attachments and files/avatars directories. This shows whether that migration succeeded and how much disk space the old raw MongoDB database files still use inside the grain, and lets you delete those raw files to free space.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: After a successful migration the data lives in FerretDB and on the filesystem, so the old raw MongoDB 3 database files can be deleted to free grain disk space. This cannot be undone.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Delete the raw MongoDB 3 database files to free disk space? The data has already been migrated to FerretDB and the filesystem. This cannot be undone.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Raw MongoDB database files deleted, freed
cards-loading-description: WeKan loads board cards automatically: a big board (over the size threshold) loads only the cards currently visible (infinite scroll) plus a live count, so it stays fast and uses less memory and bandwidth, while smaller boards load every card for the simplest, fully featured experience. There is nothing to configure. Operators can still force a mode with the CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) and CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Lazy card loading is experimental: card counters and WIP limits are accurate, but the Calendar/Table/Gantt views and multi-select reflect only the cards loaded so far. Reload open boards after changing this.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: When enabled, all links (both markdown links like [label](url) and raw HTML <a href> tags) are always shown as plain, non-clickable text in every rich text field (board and card titles, descriptions, comments, checklists, etc.). This prevents misleading clickable links. Default is off, so links stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Always show all code as plain text
always-show-code-as-text-description: When enabled, rich text is never rendered as markdown or HTML: the entire source is always shown as plain text in every rich text field (board and card titles, descriptions, comments, checklists, etc.). This reveals hidden content — HTML comments (<!-- -->), the target of markdown links, JavaScript and any other code — so all code is always visible, not clickable, and not running. Default is off, so markdown is rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: When enabled, all import features are turned off: importing a board from WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo, as well as cloning a board. The import menu options are hidden and the server rejects any import request. Default is off.
disable-all-export-description: When enabled, all export features are turned off: exporting a board as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, or to NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, and single-attachment export. The export menu options are hidden and the server rejects any export request. Default is off.
disable-import-avatars-description: When enabled, avatars (user profile pictures) are never imported. This covers WeKan JSON import, Trello import, and avatar sync from external identity providers on login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names and other data are still imported; only avatars are skipped. Default is off.
disable-export-avatars-description: When enabled, avatars (user profile pictures) are never included when exporting a board (WeKan JSON and CSV export). Usernames and other data are still exported; only avatars are omitted. Default is off.
anonymize-import-users-description: When enabled, importing a WeKan JSON board replaces every imported user's username, full name and initials with counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and the requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside imported card and comment content. No real user identity from the source board is stored. The word "user" follows the language of the person importing. Default is off.
anonymize-export-users-description: When enabled, exporting a board replaces every exported user's username, full name and initials with counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and the requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside card and comment content. The exported file carries no real user identity. The word "user" follows the language of the person exporting. Default is off.
disable-activities-description: When enabled, activity-feed entries are never recorded and never shown anywhere (board sidebar and card activity tab). No history of who did what is kept. Default is off.
disable-notifications-description: When enabled, WeKan never sends watch notifications (in-app, email or other services) for any activity. Activities can still be recorded (unless also disabled above); only the notifications are suppressed. Default is off.
disable-watch-description: When enabled, the watch feature is turned off — users cannot subscribe to boards, lists or cards to receive notifications, and any attempt to change a watch level is rejected. Default is off.
backup-description: Back up Attachments, Avatars and/or Data (all text-based collections that are not attachments or avatars). The .zip is streamed directly to the selected storage — no temporary file — as backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, containing YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars and /data. Cloud storages (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) use the credentials configured in their storage tabs.
backup-scope-description: The whole instance, or one Organization. An Organization's backup contains its boards and everything on them, including the attachments of those boards — but no user accounts and no instance settings, because those are shared by every Organization. Restoring an Organization's backup only ever writes to boards that Organization owns.
theme-override-all-tenants: Override that applies to all tenants
backup-restore-select-first: Select a backup from the list first.
backup-restore-confirm: Restore the selected backup? Attachments/avatars are written to the filesystem and data to the database according to the chosen mode.
gcs-key-filename-description: Optional: path to a service account JSON key file on the server.
gcs-credentials-description: Optional: paste the service account JSON key. Leave blank to use the key file or default credentials.
gcs-permissions-note: Give WeKan's service account read/write access to the bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → your bucket → Permissions → Grant access. In "New principals", paste the service account email — the "client_email" value from your JSON key — then choose the role "Storage Object Admin" and Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Leave blank to keep the current value.
azure-account-name-description: The name of your Azure Storage account.
azure-container-description: The blob container to store files in.
gcs-bucket-description: The name of the Cloud Storage bucket to store files in.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: leave blank (uses the region endpoint). S3-compatible: the Endpoint URL from your MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces console.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → your bucket → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → your bucket name (or Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → your user → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → choose use case 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Shown as 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Same screen as the Access key ID; 'Secret access key' is shown only once when the key is created — copy it then (or Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → your account → name shown at the top (also under Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → your account → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → your account → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → your account → Data storage → Containers → your container (or + Container to create one).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → project selector at the top → your project's ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → your bucket name (or Create to make one).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Path on the WeKan server to the downloaded service account JSON key file (created below). Use this OR paste the JSON into the field below.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → your service account → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (downloads the file). Paste its contents here, or save the file and set its path above.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Move attachment to Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Move attachment to Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Use MongoDB GridFS for file storage
migration-stop-confirm: Are you sure you want to stop all migrations?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: To have attachments and avatars visible, move them from CollectionFS to any other Storage.
s3-access-key-description: AWS S3 access key for authentication
s3-bucket-description: S3 bucket name for storing files
s3-enabled-description: Use AWS S3 or MinIO for file storage
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (e.g., s3.amazonaws.com or minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: AWS S3 secret key for authentication
writable-path-description: Base directory path for file storage
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Performs comprehensive checks and fixes for board data integrity, including list ordering, card positions, and swimlane structure.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Safely deletes empty duplicate lists. Only removes lists that have no cards AND have another list with the same title that contains cards.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Finds and restores cards and lists with missing swimlaneId or listId. Creates a 'Lost Cards' swimlane to make all lost items visible again.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Restores all archived swimlanes, lists, and cards. Automatically fixes any missing swimlaneId or listId to make items visible.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Detects and repairs missing or corrupted lists in the board structure.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Updates avatar URLs for board members to use the correct storage backend and fixes broken avatar references.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Updates all file attachment URLs on this board to use the correct storage backend and fixes broken file references.
migrations-admin-only: Only board administrators can run migrations
migrations-description: Run data integrity checks and repairs for this board. Each migration can be executed individually.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: This will perform a comprehensive migration to check and fix board data integrity. This may take a few moments. Continue?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: This will first convert any shared lists to per-swimlane lists, then delete empty lists that have a duplicate list with the same title containing cards. Only truly redundant empty lists will be removed. Continue?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: This will create a 'Lost Cards' swimlane and restore all cards and lists with missing swimlaneId or listId. This only affects non-archived items. Continue?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: This will restore ALL archived swimlanes, lists, and cards, making them visible again. Any items with missing IDs will be automatically fixed. This cannot be easily undone. Continue?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: This will detect and repair missing or corrupted lists in the board structure. Continue?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: This will update avatar URLs for board members to use the correct storage backend. Continue?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: This will update all file attachment URLs on this board to use the correct storage backend. Continue?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: No lost swimlanes, lists, or cards to restore
migration-progress-note: Please wait while we migrate your board to the latest structure...
conversion-info-text: This conversion is performed once per board and improves performance. You can continue using the board normally.
converting-board-description: Converting board structure for improved functionality. This may take a few moments.
migration-batch-size-description: Number of attachments to process in each batch (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Pause migration when CPU usage exceeds this percentage (10-90)
migration-info-text: Database migrations are performed once and improve system performance. The process continues in the background even if you close your browser.
migration-warning-text: Please do not close your browser during migration. The process will continue in the background but may take longer to complete.

username-too-short: Username must be at least 3 characters
account-created: Account created! You can now sign in.
problems-summary-help: Check the problem areas you have reviewed, then click Acknowledge to reset their new-problem count.
problems-in-progress-help: These migrations or repairs are running now. Logins can be slow, or show "Must be logged in" or a "Loading, please wait" spinner, until they finish and CPU drops.
problems-none-in-progress: No migrations or repairs are in progress.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Repaired __fixed__ card(s). __unfixable__ card(s) have no board and cannot be repaired automatically.
export-card-details: Card details (each card as in card export)
